intro: One small bowl of papaya (about 150 g) has roughly 60 kcal. Almost all of it comes from the fruit's natural sugar, so it's light but filling.

variants.name: Rojak buah with papaya and peanut sauce
Fresh papaya juice with sugar (1 glass)

diet: Yes, in fact papaya is one of the most diet-friendly fruits. Low in calories but you get a big portion, so your stomach feels full. The fibre also helps digestion. Just watch the add-ons like rojak sauce or sweetened juice, because that's what pushes the calories up.
tips: Have papaya as dessert after lunch, instead of kuih or a sweet drink.
Buy cut papaya at the pasar or fruit shop, and keep it in a container as an office snack.
Pair it with unsweetened yogurt or a boiled egg if you want more protein.

swap.name: Fresh papaya, not sweetened papaya juice
swap.why: Fresh fruit keeps the fibre and has no added sugar, so it's more filling with fewer calories.

faq.q: Is papaya really good for constipation?
faq.a: Papaya has fibre and natural enzymes that many people feel help digestion. Drink enough plain water with it for a better effect.

faq.q: Can I eat papaya at night?
faq.a: Yes. It's light and low in calories, a good night snack compared to fried food.
Ripe papaya is commonly eaten by many mums. For young or unripe papaya, better to check with your doctor first.
